PHYSICAL_IPHONE_ONLY.item: True iOS Safari SpeechRecognition behavior not reproducible by event injection
PHYSICAL_IPHONE_ONLY.reason: iOS webkitSpeechRecognition timing/endpointing is a native black box; injection covers the app's handling but not the recognizer itself.
Opening the installed WhatsApp app from wa.me/whatsapp: is an OS-level app switch; automation can only assert the URL/intent, not the app opening.
tel: opening the native dialer is an OS-level action; automation asserts the tel: URL only.
Human judgement of readability/warmth/latency on the actual screen.

PHYSICAL_IPHONE_ONLY.item: iOS standalone-PWA vs Safari-tab storage PARTITION confirmation
PHYSICAL_IPHONE_ONLY.reason: Desktop Chromium AND WebKit persistent profiles both persist correctly (proven); iOS-specific storage jar partitioning between the home-screen PWA and the Safari tab cannot be reproduced off-device. The enriched trace (display-mode/standalone/persisted) makes this a ONE-capture confirmation, not open-ended QA. This is the ONLY remaining persistence unknown.
